correctness.rationale: Panja’s full primary paper specifies Psi_w by its Kraus shift/tail operators, and the package correctly computes its action on E_ij; min(i,j) supplies the diagonal loss and indices reduce simultaneously. Finite corners are invariant, upper triangular, with spectral radius 1−r_N; strict moment log-convexity gives r_0=1>r_1>...>ρ. Uniform power-contractivity and finite-corner density prove individual compact-operator decay while P_m provides norm-one witnesses at iteration m. On diagonal operators the process is an increasing pure-birth chain; ordered uniform coupling puts the operator norm at initial state zero. Independent geometric holding times yield the stated partial-fraction survival expansion and dominant tail constant. Coupling each jump with Bernoulli(ρ) gives X_m/m→ρ via a bounded martingale strong law, while for beta weights r_k=ρ+(1−ρ)/(k+1), the nonnegative extra jumps have expected size O(log m) by the exact binomial reciprocal moment, giving CLT and logarithmic drift with uniform integrability. Independently compared finite rational survival recurrences with the spectral formula for m<=6, N<=5, ρ=1/3; every equality held.
